That fixture is an offline synthetic reconstruction (SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_FIXTURE label), not a real provider observation. I06 fixtures inherited the assumption. I13/I13R1 real probe-derived datetimes used a magnitude-aware converter (value>1e10 -> ms) and did NOT preserve native values sufficient to identify the response unit, so they cannot certify either unit. Therefore committed REAL historical evidence does NOT establish that Gate's real provider surface ever emitted milliseconds. We know our old implementation/unit label was wrong; we do NOT know that Gate changed.
